entities.summary: Christian Schad was a German painter and photographer. He was associated with the Dada and the New Objectivity movements. Schad's portraits are regarded as emblematic of the decadence of Vienna and Berlin after the First World War. Christian Schad was a authors & novelists from Miesbach (1894-08-21, Miesbach–1982-02-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
